description: `{ ok: true, value } | { ok: false, error }`: success or failure as an ordinary return value that TypeScript forces callers to check.
Domain outcomes (insufficient funds) are returned as values; bugs and infrastructure failures are thrown and handled globally.
A union whose members share a literal tag (`type`, `ok`), letting TypeScript narrow on it.
Assigning the leftover value to `never` in a `switch` default makes the compiler flag unhandled variants.
Runs the next result-returning step only after a success; the first error short-circuits the chain.
